content.title: 2026 NFL draft: All Giants picks following Dexter Lawrence trade
content.text: GIANTS2026 NFL draft: All New York Giants picks following Dexter Lawrence trade Dan BentonGiants WireApril 18, 2026Updated April 19, 2026, 5:50 a.m. ETKeep Watching3The New York Giants executed a blockbuster trade on Saturday, sending three-time Pro Bowl nose tackle Dexter Lawrence to the Cincinnati Bengals in exchange for the 10th overall pick in the 2026 NFL draft.The deal provides the Giants with significant additional draft capital as they accelerate their roster rebuild.With the acquisition, New York now controls two first-round selections: The No. 5 and No. 10 picks. The team also retains its projected seven total selections entering the draft.The Giants' full list of picks is as follows:First round: No. 5 overallFirst round: No. 10 overall (acquired from Bengals in the Lawrence trade)Second round: No. 37 overallFourth round: No. 105 overallFifth round: No. 145 overallSixth round: No. 186 overallSixth round: No. 192 overall (acquired from Miami in the Darren Waller trade)Sixth round: No. 193 overall (acquired from Dallas in the Jordan Phillips deal)Expert NFL picks: Exclusive betting insights only at USA TODAY.The Giants have no third-round or seventh-round selection.This infusion of premium picks allows the Giants to address multiple roster needs, particularly along the defensive line and other areas of weakness, as they enter the draft in Pittsburgh with enhanced flexibility to reshape the team.New York Giants 2026 free agency tracker: Signings, cuts, restructures and more Roger Goodell: Steve Tisch, siblings 'no longer' New York Giants owners Giants' John Harbaugh explains re-signing Evan Neal, Joshua Ezeudu John Harbaugh says New York Giants aren't done in free agency New York Giants named a possible trade destination for Myles GarrettA New Option for Choking Emergencies When 911 Is 7 Minutes AwayWhen anyone is choking and panic sets in, you need something that works instantly.
